findings.title: Nobody reads Orders
findings.message: Checkout publishes to Orders, but nothing consumes it: it keeps every message, unread.

fix.label: Add a consumer…
fix.needsChoice: Pick what reads Orders, then add it and connect orders to it.

findings.title: Retries to Payments need jittered backoff.
findings.message: Checkout retries in step with every other caller: waves of retries reach Payments together.

fix.label: Use jittered backoff (100 ms ×2, up to 2 s, full jitter)

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding. fix.others are other ways to make the same change: if the person prefers one, send its ops instead.
output.more: 2 more findings omitted; call check_diagram with rules to see them.
